Maria: Quick RFC follow-up. Proposal: split collector hotpath into two processes: collector-gateway (stateless validation/ingest-shaping) and collector-runtime (stateful inference + KV). Goal: reduce blast radius and speed runtime deploys. RFC link: https://go/rdw-collector-fission
Simon: Curious about end-to-end p50/p95 for sync flows. Extra hop could hurt UX-sensitive paths.
Maria: Staging microbenchmarks: cross-pod gRPC adds ~2ms p50, ~5ms p95. If colocated with unix-socket path, p50 <1ms. Default will favor in-node fast path; cross-node uses optimized gRPC.
Elaine: How to prevent gateway becoming SPOF? Also need a clear rollback path for canary.
Maria: Strategy: dark-launch gateway; phase 1 = pass-through validation+tagging; phase 2 = dual-write (gateway+runtime) for opt-in tenants + consistency checker; phase 3 = full cutover and retire old path. Rollback by disabling gateway traffic and stopping gateway writes.
Nashok: Read-after-write semantics are tricky with dual-write. What about session cache ownership?
Maria: We'll add prefer-runtime header and short TTL reads while in dual-write. Dual-write gated per-tenant. Consistency checker samples diffs and enqueues reconciliation jobs.
Kyle: Ops question: additional services mean more autoscaling groups and monitoring. Any cost or packing impact?
Maria: Gateways are CPU-light; initial rollout keeps runtime GPU pools unchanged. Expected net operational win: smaller runtime image, faster deploys, fewer runtime rollbacks.
DevOps Bot: deploy-candidate/collector-gateway: build passed (sha: a1b2c3) - smoke ok :white_check_mark:
Liz: From customer-facing side: any SLA risk or comms needed?
Maria: Phase1 risk minimal. We'll prepare advisory for phase3; maintenance windows only for tenants who ask for accelerated migration.
Simon: Can we run a 2h synthetic soak at 5% traffic before enabling writes? Validate autoscaler and queueing.
Maria: Yes. Soak plan: ramp 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% in staging; watch CPU, latency, queue length, and error budget.
Nashok: DB migration plan? Ownership column + backfill could be painful.
Maria: DB plan: add nullable ingest_owner; dual-write populates it; background backfill infers owner by last-writer heuristic; rollback clears ingest_owner for rolled-back tenants.
Maria: Short checklist (summary): release gateway image to staging; dark-launch validations; synthetic soak; enable dual-write for pilot tenants; run consistency checker 48h; backfill owner; pilot cutover + 72h monitor; customer comms; verify rollback playbook. Ping me to pair on the canary run :rocket:
